question: Where should the lord and supreme powers be worshipped?
premises: supreme on right and another on left
inference: The wise one should always worship the lord in the lotus in the middle of the trident, with the supreme above it, one on the right and another on the left.
plain_english: In the middle of the trident, in that lotus, the wise one should always worship the lord; above it the supreme, on the right, and another on the left.
